topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I walk into my apartment, and there they are—vibrant red roses in a simple glass vase, sitting on the kitchen counter. The petals glisten as if they were just cut, their fragrance subtly filling the room. I circle around the counter, studying them from all angles, but there's no sign of a card. No note, no clue. My fingers trace the smooth stem, and I catch myself holding my breath as I lean in closer, the questions swirling in my mind. Who left these here? Why now? I turn to check the door, almost expecting to find an overlooked envelope, but there’s nothing.
